name: Solace Medical Compression Therapy Gloves
description:
Graduated-compression gloves that apply precise, varying pressure across the hand and fingers to manage swelling, improve circulation, and reduce pain in arthritic or post-surgical joints. Smart-fabric elements adjust compression in real time based on embedded swelling sensors.

Worn by aging workers whose hands have been destroyed by decades of manual labor, by augmentation patients managing rejection symptoms, and by anyone whose hands hurt and who can't afford to stop using them.
functionality: Dynamic compression therapy, swelling management, pain reduction
what_it_says: Your hands are broken in ways that won't heal, but you still need them to work tomorrow.
story_hooks: A factory worker's Compression Therapy Gloves reveal abnormal swelling data patterns that don't match arthritis — something in the factory is causing a new kind of hand damage that no one has identified yet.
